headline: Trump may pardon Nvidia's chief. A surprising statement was made
summary: Donald Trump told the New York Post he does not rule out pardoning Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, though he thinks it will not be necessary. Huang is due to explain himself to Congress next week.
why: Nvidia is one of the world's largest chipmakers, and leadership and legal issues at the company are closely watched by investors. Congressional testimony can shape policy on AI chip trade.
original_headline: Trump może ułaskawić szefa Nvidii. Padła zaskakująca deklaracja
